Organiya Global LLP is preparing to introduce the Spicenza snack range in India.
paragraphs: Spicenza is the product brand. Organiya Global LLP is preparing its introduction in India and is the local point of contact for customers and business partners.
Our first range focuses on snack concepts, including sticks, crisps, a crunchy mix and a variety assortment. The products shown are upcoming and are not available to order yet.
We welcome enquiries from retailers, distributors, bulk buyers and other prospective partners. Final ingredients, pack sizes, pricing and availability will be shared when the range is ready.
